long_biography.plain_text:
Maria Arena Bell helped rebuild the financial base of the Museum of Contemporary Art in Los Angeles. As board co-chair, she and David Johnson led an endowment campaign that raised more than $120 million. She also worked with artists to turn fundraising galas into immersive performances.

Her support for film extends to preservation and teaching. Bell donated 58 feature-film prints to the Harvard Film Archive, including dye-transfer Technicolor copies valued for their stable colour. The collection is available for study on site. She also taught television pilot writing and serial storytelling through Harvard's extension programme for six years.
